parent_objective: design causal history-necessity task/gate family after fixed-budget profile pilot is negative for history necessity
blocked_by: M1389 pivots away from blind profile scaling to causal history-necessity task design
supersedes: running another profile repeat without a new history-necessity task
claiming recurrent belief from standard public profile pilot

public_gates: M1390 must design history-necessity tasks before new mining/training
M1390 must define matched-current or same-current intervention requirements
M1390 must not train, run PPO, run new evaluation, promote, use private holdout, export corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not weaken claim standards after negative profile results
do not claim level3 self-identification from design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs tasks and gates that make command-response history causally necessary after profile pilot negatives
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: task/gate design only; no training, new evaluation, PPO, promotion, private holdout, high-fidelity, profile-ranking, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design only repeats profile comparison without making history causal
stop if current-frame substitution controls are omitted
stop if accepted-seed/source-diversity thresholds are omitted
stop if source-rich seed-thin limitations are ignored
fallback_plan: if matched-current task design is too hard, route to source mining design first
if source-rich rows remain seed-thin, design a broader source distribution before training
if current simulator cannot express needed interventions, route to simulator/task extension design
if no causal history task can be specified, synthesize branch and stop the self-ID claim route

admission_evidence: M1389 finds fixed-budget profile pilot negative for finite-window history necessity and online GRU hidden advantage
M1377/M1379 provide temporal source-rich diagnostics but remain seed-thin
M1389 blocks more blind profile scaling
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: next mining or implementation route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1390 must explicitly design against current-frame substitution by requiring matched-current or same-current interventions.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design uses M1379 source-rich temporal positives and M1388 profile negatives as constraints.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If causal tasks cannot be specified with source diversity, record blocker and avoid self-ID claims.
allowed_claims: causal history-necessity task/gate design and next route
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A causal history-necessity task/gate family can be designed to test history dependence directly after standard profile comparison fails to expose it.
success_criteria: design specifies task families and interventions
design specifies accepted-row and accepted-seed/source-diversity thresholds
design chooses next mining or implementation route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: design repeats standard profile comparison without making history causal
design routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or corpus export without source design
decision_rule: M1390 passes if it designs causal history-necessity tasks and chooses the next source-mining or implementation route before training or claim expansion.
